domain.source: explicit finite CNF, each clause at least2 physical occurrences; repeats allowed; each occurrence belongs to exactly one clause
domain.rings: only appeared variables, arbitrary order, explicit padding to length>=3, arbitrary dummy polarity
domain.parameters: binary rational3/4<rho<1; all real x=y=1/2; dummy x1 and no u eligibility
domain.P: exact original q/b/u and M/C finite matrix; no h/D/physical common R or preload
domain.empty: one idle original machine, zerojobs, OPT0

conclusions.decoder: every complete original actual schedule with strict peak<3/2; directly scan actual identities and rings, no normalization or search
conclusions.universal_output: deterministic bit-polynomial all original jobs actual peak<=3/2 for every formula; nonempty chosen baseline exactly3/2, no source assignment input
conclusions.SAT_output: given satisfying assignment produce all-original-job actual peak<=1, selected C contains original q+u, b returned
conclusions.nonempty_lower: separately proved for every complete schedule; not from optional unit eligibility
conclusions.sharp_boundary: UNSAT equality witness invalidates decoder at <=3/2

proof_variants.author_nonempty_lower: C<1 forces R all and then E all, u+q1 contradiction
proof_variants.independent_nonempty_lower: C<1 implies slot saturation, any u C has b>=3/2 or q+u1

counts.minimal_padding: N<=L+2v; extra dummy list charged at actualN
counts.total_bit_complexity: rational input, explicit loops and load sums; no inverse denominator or threshold gap expansion

not_certified: B arbitrary-weight active matching by C reviewer
